column1: # Which tracked *.sh files this repository does NOT put through ShellCheck, and why.
# Format, tab-separated, one row per exempted path prefix:
# A prefix ends on a PATH COMPONENT boundary, not on a character: `evidence` covers
# evidence/b06/run.sh and never evidence2/dump.sh. Write the trailing slash anyway — it
# says which of the two you meant without making the reader check the matcher.
# A prefix here is a written claim about files that exist, so a prefix matching no tracked
# file is an error rather than a permission, and an empty reason is refused. Everything not
# covered by a row has to sit under a directory a ShellCheck step already scans.
# THERE IS NO WILDCARD IN THIS COLUMN. `*` is not "everything"; it is a path prefix that
# matches no tracked file, and is refused as one. The whole-checkout sentinel belongs to the
# workflow side, where `scandir: .` mints it. A row reading `*` once exempted the entire
# repository, which is why the verifier now carries a fixture for it.
# tools/verify-shellcheck-coverage.sh enforces both directions and CI runs it.
